title: Exclude room identifiers
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 1, p. 1
proposedRule: Exclude room numbers from qualifying patient identifiers.
needsCoreFeature: Validate identifier categories; banner content is not typed in v1.
notes: Two-identifier banner exists; exclusion of location identifiers is not checked.

title: Label specimens at bedside
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 2, p. 1
proposedRule: Label specimen containers while the patient is present.
needsCoreFeature: Specimen-label event and patient-presence attestation.
notes: Physical presence cannot be established by screen certification alone.

title: Distinguish newborn identities
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.01.01 EP 3, p. 1
proposedRule: Use distinct newborn identification methods.
needsCoreFeature: Newborn status and identifier/display validation.
notes: Illustrative naming and banding methods are examples, not individually mandatory.

title: Define critical-result recipients
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.02.01 EP 1, p. 1
proposedRule: Define authorized critical-result reporters and recipients.
needsCoreFeature: Critical-result classification and recipient-routing policy.
notes: Atomic policy subitem of regulations.md R2-11; v1 acknowledgment is not evidence of delivery.

title: Control alarm disabling
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.05.01 EP 2, p. 3
proposedRule: Define when clinical alarms may be disabled.
needsCoreFeature: Device alarm controls and policy conditions.
notes: Clinical device alarms are distinct from the existing medication CDS alert tiers.

title: Authorize alarm deactivation
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.01.05.01 EP 2, p. 3
proposedRule: Define who may turn clinical alarms off.
needsCoreFeature: Device-alarm authorization model.
notes: A UI adaptation must preserve the authorized-role restriction if device controls are added.

title: Use validated suicide screening
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 2, p. 24
proposedRule: Screen eligible patients using a validated suicide tool.
needsCoreFeature: Eligibility predicate, validated questionnaire and screening result.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. Disposition gate is a proposed local implementation; depressionScreen/PHQ-2 is not equivalent.

title: Assess suicidal intent
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 3, p. 24
proposedRule: Directly assess suicidal intent after positive screening.
needsCoreFeature: Suicide assessment fields and predicate.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. This is one assessment component, not a complete assessment.

title: Record suicide risk level
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 4, p. 24
proposedRule: Document the overall suicide risk level.
needsCoreFeature: Suicide risk assessment element and predicate.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation.

title: Record suicide mitigation plan
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.08.01.01 EP 4, p. 24
proposedRule: Document the suicide risk mitigation plan.
needsCoreFeature: Risk mitigation plan element and predicate.
notes: Applies to behavioral-health-primary care; screening age 12+. EPs 3–7 also cover any patient expressing suicidal ideation. Do not equate a documented plan with completion of physical protective measures.

title: Include medication name
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include the drug or solution name on procedural labels.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include medication strength
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include strength on procedural medication labels.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include diluent name
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include diluent name unless apparent from the container.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include diluent volume
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include diluent volume unless apparent from the container.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include expiration date
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include expiration date unless the hospital-defined short-procedure exception applies.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Include expiration time
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.03.01 EP 3, p. 44
proposedRule: Include expiration time unless the hospital-defined short-procedure exception applies.
needsCoreFeature: Procedural label model, content validation and exception predicate.
notes: Applies on and off the sterile field; label-generation proposal, not an existing signOpNote requirement.

title: Use anticoagulant reversal protocols
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.04.01 EP 1, p. 44
proposedRule: Use approved evidence-based anticoagulant reversal protocols.
needsCoreFeature: Therapeutic anticoagulation/bleeding predicate and protocol information.
notes: Excludes routine short-term VTE prophylaxis. coagLabs is an adjacent v1 panel, not a reversal protocol; existingInSpec=false.

title: Provide written discharge medications
citation: Joint Commission Hospital National Performance Goals, effective January 2026; NPG.14.05.01 EP 4, p. 45
proposedRule: Provide written medication information at discharge or outpatient encounter end.
needsCoreFeature: Patient-facing medication-list delivery evidence.
notes: dischargeMedRec is captured in v1; delivery of a written list is not established by that field alone.

title: Maintain prohibited abbreviation rules
citation: Joint Commission public Do Not Use List page; IM.02.02.01 EPs 2–3; public explanation of IM.02.02.01
proposedRule: Apply the hospital prohibited-abbreviation list to medication documentation.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Related to R2-10; public landing page verified. Dynamic FAQ body did not render; individual examples below are verified from the official ISMP PDF.

title: Spell out international units
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use international units instead of IU.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell out daily
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Use daily instead of QD and its punctuation/case variants.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell out every other day
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Use every other day instead of QOD and its variants.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Use mL for volume
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use mL instead of cc.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Spell microgram units safely
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Doses/Measurement Units
proposedRule: Use mcg instead of the microgram symbol.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Disambiguate discharge and discontinue
citation: ISMP List of Error-Prone Abbreviations, Symbols, and Dose Designations (2024); Abbreviations for Frequencies/Directions
proposedRule: Write discharge or discontinue explicitly instead of D/C.
needsCoreFeature: Context-sensitive medication text validator.
notes: Atomic expansion of R2-10; ISMP guidance, binding=false. Preserve full-token matching rather than banning letters inside words.

title: Record metric weight
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 3(b), p. 5
proposedRule: Record weight only in metric units.
notes: V1 is stricter: kg only, whereas ISMP also permits grams. Existing entry requirement; regulations.md E5.

title: Measure encounter weight
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 3(a), p. 5
proposedRule: Obtain measured weight at admission and appropriate encounters.
needsCoreFeature: Measured-weight provenance and encounter linkage.
notes: Do not delay life-saving treatment to weigh a major-trauma patient; laboratory-only encounters are excluded. V1 has a weight entry, not this provenance/exception check.

title: Reject historical dosing weight
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 3(a), p. 5
proposedRule: Avoid relying on historical weight for the encounter.
needsCoreFeature: Weight source/measurement-time validation.
notes: V1 comments describe today, but its entry gate does not validate measurement provenance; this is additional validation.

title: Select oral-compatible syringes
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; ARCHIVED BP 4, pp. 6, 21
proposedRule: Dispense non-unit-dose oral liquids in oral or ISO-compatible enteral syringes.
needsCoreFeature: Dispensing device/packaging attributes and pharmacy workflow.
notes: Explicitly ARCHIVED in the requested 2024–2025 booklet; historical best practice retained there, not a new active 2024 practice. Order device choice is only an EHR implementation proxy.

title: Use metric dosing devices
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; ARCHIVED BP 5, pp. 6, 22
proposedRule: Select oral liquid dosing devices with metric-only scales.
needsCoreFeature: Physical-device inventory/inspection outside UI semantics.
notes: ARCHIVED in requested booklet. EHR discharge/device instructions can support procurement and use; a screen checker cannot certify printed syringe graduations.

title: Default methotrexate weekly
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 2(a), p. 4
proposedRule: Default oral methotrexate orders to weekly dosing.
needsCoreFeature: Medication-specific default constraint.
notes: A human may change a default; the separate daily-indication verification must still apply. Not an absolute ban on daily oncology treatment.

title: Verify daily methotrexate indication
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 2(b), p. 4
proposedRule: Require appropriate oncologic indication verification for daily oral methotrexate.
needsCoreFeature: Drug/frequency predicate and oncologic-indication validation.
notes: Related to regulations.md S-ISMP-mtx; v1 indication capture alone does not verify an appropriate oncologic indication.

title: Confirm methotrexate teach-back
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 2(c), p. 4
proposedRule: Have patients repeat methotrexate discharge dosing instructions.
needsCoreFeature: Teach-back completion and drug predicate.
notes: A generic instructions entry in v1 does not establish patient comprehension.

title: Target independent double checks
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 19(d), p. 17
proposedRule: Select highest-risk medications for independent double checks.
notes: V1 implements distinct-nurse cosign for its high-alert subset. Source examples: chemotherapy, opioid infusions, IV insulin, heparin infusions. Do not extend manual checks indiscriminately to every high-alert drug.

title: Layer high-alert safeguards
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 19(c), p. 17
proposedRule: Combine weaker controls with stronger high-alert safeguards.
needsCoreFeature: Medication-specific safeguard profiles beyond one alert/cosign.
notes: Static policy proposal: a label or educational popup alone cannot satisfy the safeguard profile.

title: Educate high-alert recipients
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 19(e), p. 17
proposedRule: Provide targeted education for selected high-alert medications.
needsCoreFeature: Drug-specific education evidence.
notes: Generic patientInstructions does not prove targeted education or family involvement.

title: Define automatic consultation triggers
citation: ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices for Hospitals, 2024–2025; BP 19(g), p. 17
proposedRule: Define criteria triggering medication education consultation.
needsCoreFeature: Consultation criteria and routed consult/task creation.
notes: Consultation is the recommendation; passive tier is a proposed UI choice, not ISMP wording.

title: Flag injectable tranexamic acid
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include tranexamic acid injection in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag concentrated potassium chloride
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include potassium chloride injection concentrate in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include neuromuscular blocking agents in the acute-care high-alert catalog.

notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag chemotherapy
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include oral and parenteral chemotherapy in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag neuraxial medications
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include epidural and intrathecal medications in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag every opioid route
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include opioids by every administration route in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag pediatric oral sedation
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include oral moderate/minimal sedation agents for children in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag hypertonic saline
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024), p. 1; Classes/Categories or Specific Medications
proposedRule: Include sodium chloride injection above 0.9% in the acute-care high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Explicit medication catalog membership in the FHIR fact adapter.
notes: Mapping identifies the existing high-alert hook, not an already-enumerated v1 drug class. Choose local layered safeguards; list membership alone does not mandate a second-nurse check.

title: Flag ambulatory immunosuppressants
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care Settings (2021), p. 1; Classes/Categories of Medications
proposedRule: Include oral and parenteral immunosuppressants in the community high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Community-specific high-alert catalog and safeguards.
notes: 2021 community edition opened directly; do not substitute the acute-care list. Classification informs local safeguards, not an automatic contraindication or mandatory popup.

title: Flag measured pediatric liquids
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care Settings (2021), p. 1; Classes/Categories of Medications
proposedRule: Include pediatric liquids requiring measurement in the community high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Community-specific high-alert catalog and safeguards.
notes: 2021 community edition opened directly; do not substitute the acute-care list. Classification informs local safeguards, not an automatic contraindication or mandatory popup.

title: Flag pregnancy-contraindicated medications
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care Settings (2021), p. 1; Classes/Categories of Medications
proposedRule: Include medications contraindicated during pregnancy in the community high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Community-specific high-alert catalog and safeguards.
notes: 2021 community edition opened directly; do not substitute the acute-care list. Classification informs local safeguards, not an automatic contraindication or mandatory popup.

title: Flag ambulatory sulfonylureas
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care Settings (2021), p. 1; Classes/Categories of Medications
proposedRule: Include oral sulfonylurea hypoglycemics in the community high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Community-specific high-alert catalog and safeguards.
notes: 2021 community edition opened directly; do not substitute the acute-care list. Classification informs local safeguards, not an automatic contraindication or mandatory popup.

title: Flag all ambulatory insulins
citation: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care Settings (2021), p. 1; Classes/Categories of Medications
proposedRule: Include all insulin formulations and strengths in the community high-alert catalog.
needsCoreFeature: Community-specific high-alert catalog and safeguards.
notes: 2021 community edition opened directly; do not substitute the acute-care list. Classification informs local safeguards, not an automatic contraindication or mandatory popup.

title: Reassess at 50 MME
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 4, implementation considerations
proposedRule: Reassess benefits and risks before increasing to at least 50 MME/day.
needsCoreFeature: All-source MME calculation, dose-change predicate and benefit/risk panel.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. R2-16 overlap; a guidepost, not a ceiling.

title: Offer naloxone at 50 MME
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendations 4 and 8
proposedRule: Offer naloxone when total opioid dosage reaches 50 MME/day.
needsCoreFeature: CDC 50-MME predicate distinct from v1 naloxoneRisk.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. V1 uses 90 MME or concurrent benzodiazepine; broader trigger is new.

title: Offer naloxone after overdose
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 8, implementation considerations
proposedRule: Offer naloxone to opioid recipients with prior overdose.
needsCoreFeature: Prior-overdose risk predicate.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. No requirement that the patient purchase it.

title: Offer naloxone for sleep-breathing risk
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 8, implementation considerations
proposedRule: Offer naloxone to opioid recipients with sleep-disordered breathing.
needsCoreFeature: Sleep-disordered-breathing risk predicate.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md.

title: Review concurrent benzodiazepine risk
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 11
proposedRule: Review benefits versus risks when opioids and benzodiazepines overlap.
needsCoreFeature: Overlap predicate and explicit benefit/risk review.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. Caution permits individualized co-prescribing; not an absolute prohibition.

title: Review PDMP before opioid prescriptions
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 9, implementation considerations
proposedRule: Ideally review PDMP data before each opioid prescription.
needsCoreFeature: Opioid-specific PDMP trigger and practicability handling.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. Availability/access exceptions matter; v1 CURES trigger is different.

title: Review long-term PDMP quarterly
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 9, implementation considerations
proposedRule: Review PDMP at least every three months during long-term therapy.
needsCoreFeature: Calendar-month review interval and longitudinal PDMP event.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. Do not encode three calendar months as a fixed 90-day receipt.

title: Avoid abrupt opioid discontinuation
citation: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain (2022), MMWR 71(RR-3); Recommendation 5
proposedRule: Avoid abrupt discontinuation unless a life-threatening issue warrants it.
needsCoreFeature: Taper plan, current dose and clinical exception validation.
notes: CDC adult outpatient scope; exclusions in guidance.md. Automated refill denial must not silently force discontinuation.

title: Capture antibiotic dose
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Assessment Tool, Action, p. 29
proposedRule: Document dose for each antibiotic prescription.
notes: Assessment asks whether a facility policy requires this. V1 already requires the generic field on every order line; older v2-only narrative does not match the current V1 source.

title: Capture antibiotic duration
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Assessment Tool, Action, p. 29
proposedRule: Document duration for each antibiotic prescription.
notes: Assessment asks whether a facility policy requires this. V1 already requires the generic field on every order line; older v2-only narrative does not match the current V1 source.

title: Capture antibiotic indication
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Assessment Tool, Action, p. 29
proposedRule: Document indication for each antibiotic prescription.
notes: Assessment asks whether a facility policy requires this. V1 already requires the generic field on every order line; older v2-only narrative does not match the current V1 source.

title: Reassess antibiotic spectrum
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Antibiotic timeouts, p. 19
proposedRule: At antibiotic timeout, reassess whether therapy can be narrowed.
needsCoreFeature: Timed antibiotic review task and reassessment decision.
notes: Provider-led supplemental review; not a substitute for stewardship audit. Optimal timing is not established; 48–72 hours describes trial evidence, not a universal deadline.

title: Reassess antibiotic route
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Antibiotic timeouts, p. 19
proposedRule: At antibiotic timeout, reassess intravenous-to-oral conversion.
needsCoreFeature: Antibiotic reassessment task and route-conversion eligibility.
notes: Local protocol determines eligibility; the recommendation does not authorize automatic conversion of every IV antibiotic.

title: Adjust antibiotics for organ dysfunction
citation: CDC Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs (2019); Other interventions, p. 19
proposedRule: Adjust antibiotic dosing when organ dysfunction requires it.
needsCoreFeature: Renal/hepatic dosing rules and patient-specific eligibility.
notes: Adjacent v1 relevantLabs panel is required only for refill decisions; no antibiotic renal-dose gate exists.

title: Record vaccine injection site
citation: CDC/ACIP General Best Practice Guidelines, Vaccine Administration; Multiple Injections
proposedRule: Document each vaccine injection site.
notes: Recommendation directly supports site capture, which the vaccine-record statute does not explicitly list. For multiple injections, retain per-vaccine correspondence.

title: Record post-vaccine adverse events
citation: CDC/ACIP General Best Practice Guidelines, Vaccination Records, July 17, 2024; Records of Health Care Providers
proposedRule: Update permanent records with documented post-vaccination adverse events.
needsCoreFeature: Longitudinal adverse-event update action.
notes: Guidance recommendation, separate from statutory vaccine-record fields or VAERS duties.

title: Record vaccine-related serology
citation: CDC/ACIP General Best Practice Guidelines, Vaccination Records, July 17, 2024; Records of Health Care Providers
proposedRule: Update permanent records with vaccine-preventable-disease serology results.
needsCoreFeature: Immunization record linkage to relevant serology.
notes: Guidance recommendation; result acknowledgment alone does not update immunization evidence.

title: Check catch-up vaccine intervals
citation: CDC/ACIP Child Immunization Schedule Notes, 2025 edition, July 2, 2025; How to use the schedule, item 2
proposedRule: Check the catch-up interval before recommending a delayed vaccine dose.
needsCoreFeature: Versioned vaccine-series interval calculation and validity rules.
notes: Opened official page identifies itself as the 2025 schedule, not 2026. Pin this edition for the demo; v1 displays history/forecast but does not verify schedule calculations.

title: Consolidate synonymous allergy terms
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: CPOE with Decision Support; RP 1.2, p. 11
proposedRule: Map synonymous allergen and reaction terms into consolidated picklists.
needsCoreFeature: Coded allergy/reaction vocabularies and synonym normalization.
notes: New detail beyond R2-13 structured capture. Example source terms are dyspnea and shortness of breath.

title: Separate environmental allergens
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: CPOE with Decision Support; RP 1.2, p. 11
proposedRule: Place environmental allergens in the problem list rather than drug allergies.
needsCoreFeature: Allergen category and storage-target validation.
notes: Applies to environmental allergens such as pollen; medication, contrast and latex allergies remain in the structured allergy workflow.

title: Tier alerts by severity
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: CPOE with Decision Support; RP 2.2, p. 13
proposedRule: Assign alert presentation tiers by clinical severity.
notes: V1 alert specifications and A1–A4 already preserve severity tiers. The mapping tier denotes its critical-alert implementation; passive lower-severity alerts also exist. Specific tier assignments are local policy.

title: Recheck drugs after allergy updates
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: CPOE with Decision Support; RP 2.2, p. 13
proposedRule: Recheck all active medications when a new allergy is entered.
needsCoreFeature: Allergy-update event and active-medication interaction evaluation.
notes: V1 checks drugAllergy at commits; it has no allergy-update action that triggers reverse checks. Interruptive tier is a proposed choice for clinically critical matches.

title: Show weight during ordering
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: CPOE with Decision Support; RP 2.3, p. 17
proposedRule: Keep patient weight visible during order entry.
needsCoreFeature: Order-entry phase visibility requirement, beyond commit-screen review.
notes: V1 captures weight and shows doseCheck at signing; neither establishes weight visibility throughout order entry. Related to existing regulations.md E8/R3.

title: Escalate unacknowledged critical results
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: Test Results Reporting and Follow-Up; RP 2.5, p. 16
quote: automatic escalation if there is no response
proposedRule: Escalate life-threatening result notifications if rapid acknowledgment is absent.
needsCoreFeature: Notification acknowledgment, timeout and alternate-recipient routing.
notes: Atomic component of R2-11. No numerical universal deadline is supplied here; escalation must run even when no user opens the result.

title: Notify patients of normal results
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER Guide: Test Results Reporting and Follow-Up; RP 3.4, p. 26
proposedRule: Ensure timely patient notification of normal results.
needsCoreFeature: Normal-result notification requirement and delivery evidence.
notes: V1 requires patientMessage only for abnormalResult. Delivery/notification differs from typing text; do not turn an illustrative outside policy deadline into a universal SAFER limit.
